# Correctness verification — BLOCK

The candidate closes one task whose recorded acceptance criterion is still false; retain that task in review or resolve the criterion/evidence mismatch before claiming completion.

Reviewed candidate: f24ed4b2bd1acda323d9ec9a6ae494f30b561bf9.
Compared with: f98dcd552fc016441478b4fe15920c9f8ad3f05e.
Lens: factual and lifecycle correctness.
Confidence: high, based on a direct contradiction and a fresh read-only probe; no statistical confidence measurement was made.
Environment: /Users/quentinmiao/.codex/worktrees/bbbb/agentfold; Darwin arm64; Git 2.55.0; Python 3.14.7.

## Genuine finding

### [P2] Keep the fold task in review until its unscoped acceptance claim is resolved

Location introduced by this candidate: tasks/4_done/2026-08-18-fold-the-queue-machine-record/worklog.md:153–154 and the move of that task into 4_done.

The task's unchanged criterion at task.md:38–39 says:

> The new predicates report zero findings when run unscoped over every tracked
> Markdown file in the repository.

Its preserved verification.md:517–540 instead reports 38 unscoped findings, including three fold-shape findings, and explicitly explains that those findings are outside the intended scope. The new closeout says all nine acceptance criteria support the completed scope, although the zero-unscoped criterion is contradicted by that evidence. The lower and upper recovery records supply full-suite and real-repository checks, but do not supply a later all-predicates, all-Markdown zero result.

This remains observable at the reviewed candidate. Calling the current fold-shape predicate directly on three tracked Markdown files, with bytecode writing disabled, returned:

    .github/pull_request_template.md ['an item carries at most one fold, and it holds `## For the record`']
    message-queue/open-actions.md ['an item carries at most one fold, and it holds `## For the record`']
    templates/pull-request.md ['an item carries at most one fold, and it holds `## For the record`']

The predicate checks the arrangement of the allowed metadata fold. These files legitimately use other folds, so this finding does not recommend widening production enforcement or rewriting them. It is a completion-record defect: before the candidate the task was in review; afterward it is declared done without resolving the known acceptance mismatch. A checked box and a merged implementation do not establish semantic acceptance.

Bounded remediation: retain this task in 3_in-review for this maintenance pass and update seven-closeout claims to six. Alternatively, resolve and document the acceptance scope under the task's governing authority, with truthful evidence, before completing it. Preserve historical transcripts. The nine-criteria completion claim and count must not remain unqualified.

## Other checks and refutation attempts

- Could not break the other six closures. The installer task has explicit real linked-worktree, concurrent-install and failure-path transcripts; the receipt task retains its tested fail-closed rendering limit; the instruction task has recorded reconciliation and full-suite output. The source-evidence and two recovery tasks retain their actual checked candidates, lower/upper verification, platform skips, and external-review limit. The unfinished weak-author evaluation is not an acceptance requirement of the source-evidence task and is explicitly left unclaimed by this candidate.
- Verified that nine cited delivery commits are ancestors of both audit base and candidate. The internal merge at 6b6b74a preserves the instruction work; 0c9387e brings both recovery layers into the main lineage.
- The byte-preservation check found seven moved task folders, 58 renamed records, 44 exact byte matches, and 14 strict append-only changes. Every changed moved file is worklog.md or verification.md. Both moved requirements files remain byte-identical.
- Compared desired-state goal headings, provenance lines and fenced owner words: all ten of each selected category remain unchanged.
- Roadmap corrections about batch-read measurement, Stage 0/backfill, readability advisories, recovered layers, and the outstanding layered-workspace start dependency agree with inspected history and records. The batch task explicitly reports that full-suite measurements did not establish a speedup.
- The corrected coordination plan agrees with the accepted rule that human questions do not justify 2_blocked. The live manifest start dependency remains in place.
- The five-scenario task maps operational work to a derived, unclaimed child and pickup. It preserves original requirements through the parent and does not claim that any experiment or operations manual already exists.
- Inspected current mutation and claim-history code. The planned mutation regression and unrelated old-claim safety control are useful next checks; this review did not execute either reproduction and makes no observed-runtime claim about them.

## Optional observations

None. The issue above is a semantic completion mismatch, not a style preference.

## Checks not run and limits

No full suite, installer, reconciler CLI, remote-provider query, browser, Git mutation, or scenario experiment ran in this review. No fixture or cache was written. Historical transcripts are evidence of their recorded candidates only. I did not re-run the historical 38-findings measurement; the fresh probe establishes three current counterexamples, which suffice to refute zero. The only intended write is this review artifact.

I used the mechanically composed request/criteria/diff packet and repository contracts, task criteria, designs, historical verification and source. I did not read the orchestration run's worker findings/progress or other current verifier verdicts.
